newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhs to export 5-6 mln T grain in '96 - minister.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhs to export 5-6 mln T grain in '96 - minister.

text.p: Kazakhstan will export at least 5-6 million tonnes of grain in 1996, Zhanybek Karibzhanov, deputy prime minister responsible for agriculture, said on Wednesday.
"Kazakhstan will export no less than 5-6 million tonnes (of grain)," Karibzhanov told a news conference.
On October 7 the country's agriculture ministry said this year's harvest was 90 percent complete at around 11 million tonnes.

Karibzhanov said Russian demand for Kazakh grain was "holding" despite a better harvest in Russia this year. He said lower harvests in eastern Europe, India and China made prospects for Kazakh wheat exports realistic.
He said there was demand from countries in the Transcaucasus, and from Turkmenistan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and China.
A spokesman for Kazakhstan's agricultural exchange said Russian demand for Kazakh grain would be around 2-3 million tonnes this year.
